title: Guided Engineering Test Cases Schema
description: Collection of concrete test cases derived from a spec's acceptance criteria. Authored via prompt.test-cases.from-spec.yaml.

specId.description: The spec these test cases verify.

specVersion.description: The specVersion these test cases were derived against. Bump if the spec changes.

acceptanceCriterionId.description: The acceptance criterion this test case verifies.

given.description: Pre-condition mirrored from the acceptance criterion.

when.description: Action mirrored from the acceptance criterion.

then.description: Outcome mirrored from the acceptance criterion.

inputs.description: Concrete input values used by this test case. Free-form object — shape depends on the feature under test.

expectedOutputs.description: Concrete expected outputs. Free-form object — shape depends on the feature under test.
